name: Orbital Settings
description: Design Graph of the Orbital Settings screen (SettingsPage) including the PageHeader instance it renders.

properties.note: Reusable UserControl: title + subtitle on the left, search trigger on the right, 1px bottom border.

properties.behavior: Tapped raises the static PageHeader.SearchRequested event

properties.layout: vertical AutoLayout, gap 24; profile card full-width, then a two-column grid (about | paths+actions) with a 16px gutter

properties.description: Bordered, rounded grouping container: Surface-1 background, Surface-3 1px border, 12px radius, 20px padding.

evidence.rationale: Four section containers on the screen share the declared OrbitalCardStyle and the same section-title-over-content structure, so they are instances of one reusable card concept.

properties.initialValue: Loaded from SettingsService.GetStoredUsername() on page load

properties.behavior: Click saves the trimmed textbox value via SettingsService.SaveUsername

nodes.text: This name appears in the homepage greeting.

properties.note: 32px logo centered inside a 48x48 rounded Surface-2 tile

properties.description: Horizontal label + right-aligned value pair in small mono type; label at 50% text emphasis, value at 72%.

evidence.rationale: Four consecutive Grids in the About card repeat the identical label-left / value-right structure with identical styles, differing only in label text and value binding.

properties.description: Stacked label over wrapping path value, both in small mono type; label at 50% emphasis, value at 72% with TextWrapping.

evidence.rationale: Three consecutive StackPanels in the Paths card repeat the identical label-over-value structure with identical styles and 8px spacing, differing only in label and binding.

properties.description: Icon + text low-emphasis (ghost) button, stretched full-width with left-aligned content; 14px FontIcon and label with 8px gap.

evidence.rationale: Three consecutive Buttons in the Actions card share the declared OrbitalGhostButtonSm style and the identical icon+text StackPanel content structure, differing only in glyph, label, and wired action.

properties.behavior: Click removes all recent projects via IProjectContext, then shows a confirmation ContentDialog

unresolved.question: What UI does the header search trigger open? SearchBorder raises the static PageHeader.SearchRequested event, but no subscriber is visible in the allowed sources.
unresolved.reason: The event handler lives outside the modeled files, so the destination cannot be asserted without inventing behavior.

unresolved.question: What object provides the bindings VersionDisplay, EnvStatus.*, DotNetDisplay, PlatformInfo, ProjectRoot, RecentsPath, and SkillsPath? No DataContext or ViewModel is set in the visible page files.
unresolved.reason: Binding paths are declared in XAML, but the backing model is outside the allowed sources; runtime values are unknown (fallbacks shown as '...').

unresolved.question: What are the exact duration and easing of the FadeUp entrance animation? metadata.notes: Style-level interaction visuals (button PointerOver/Pressed/Disabled visual states, search bar hover recoloring) were deliberately excluded per the state-altitude rule. Tokens are limited to values the Settings surface consumes directly or via styles it uses.
